d:
A party, some friends, and absolutely no work stress... what could possibly go wrong?
Episode 3 of Please Find Attached Season 3 is here!
Shaurya and Sanya decide to do something fun for once—a party, good vibes, their favourite people, and a chance to take a break from the chaos of work.
But when an unexpected guest shows up, the evening takes a slightly different turn.
A familiar face from Sanya's past makes an appearance, and suddenly things get a little awkward, a little confusing, and a lot more interesting.
